summary: Hajime Sakurabe studied Buddhist studies and Indology at Otani University under Issai Funahashi and Susumu Yamaguchi, earning his PhD. He taught at Otani University (1949–1995), Nava Nalanda Mahavihara (~1957–1959), and Doho University (~1995–2005).
A philosopher, Hajime Tanabe studied at the University of Tokyo and Kyoto University under Kitaro Nishida. He held posts at Tohoku University (~1913–1919) and Kyoto University (~1919–1945).

Hakuju Ui studied at the University of Tokyo under Junjirō Takakusu and Tübingen under Richard von Garbe. Active in Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy, he taught at Tokyo, Waseda, Tohoku, Komazawa, and Nagoya universities.
Halle O'Neal specializes in Japanology, Buddhist studies, and archaeology. She completed her Doctor of Philosophy at the University of Kansas (~2005–2011) under the supervision of Sherry Fowler.

A Buddhist studies and Indology scholar, Saddhatissa studied at Sastrodoya Pirivena, Vidyodaya Pirivena, Banaras Hindu University, and the University of Edinburgh. He held posts at Vikramashila Pirivena, Mahabodhi College, BHU, SOAS, Toronto, Oxford, and London Buddhist Vihara.
Hank Glassman works in Japanology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies. He held faculty posts at Haverford College, attested in 2009 and 2019.

Hanns Oertel was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Yale under William Dwight Whitney. He held positions at Yale (1891–1917), Harvard (1903–1904), Basel (1920), Marburg (~1925), and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (1925–1935).
Hannu Riikonen studied at the University of Helsinki from ~1967 to 1978 and served there as a professor from ~1999 to 2016.

Hans Hartog, a scholar of Indology and linguistics, studied at Tübingen, Kirchliche Hochschule Bethel, and Munich. He earned his PhD at Marburg (1937–1939) under Friedrich Heiler, also studying under Hanns Oertel and others.

Hans Henrich Hock is a linguist and Indologist who studied at Yale University (~1962–1967). He served as a Professor of Linguistics and Sanskrit at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (~1967–2013).

Hans T. Bakker, an Indologist and scholar of religious studies, studied under Jacob Ensink. He held posts at the University of Groningen (~1982–1995; attested 1999–2021) and served as a curator at the British Museum.
Hans-Werner Köhler was an Indology scholar who studied under Eduard Hermann and doctoral supervisor Ernst Waldschmidt (attested 1973).
Hanung Kim, working in Tibetology and archaeology, earned a Master's degree at Columbia University and a Doctor of Philosophy at Harvard University under the supervision of Leonard van der Kuijp.

Hara Prasad Sastri was a scholar of Indology and Buddhist studies. He served as Principal at Sanskrit College and University (attested 1905) and Joint Philological Secretary at the Asiatic Society (attested 1905–1911).

Harald Hauptmann, a scholar of archaeology and Iranian and Central Asian studies, studied at Heidelberg University (~1958–1964). He held posts at Heidelberg University, the German Archaeological Institute at Istanbul, and the Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities.

Haraprasad Shastri studied at Sanskrit College and Presidency University, Kolkata. A scholar of Indology, archaeology, and Buddhist studies, he held posts at Hare School (~1878–1883), Presidency University, Sanskrit College and University, and the University of Dhaka (~1921–1924).

Hari Damodar Velankar, a scholar in Indology, studied under H. M. Bhadkamkar. He held posts at Wilson College, Mumbai (attested 1944) and served as Joint Director at Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan (attested 1959–1960).
Hari Shankar Prasad works in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied at Banaras Hindu University and under Ramakant Tripathi and Jan Willem de Jong.

Haridas Bhattacharyya, working in philosophy and Indology, studied at Scottish Church College and the University of Calcutta. He held posts at the University of Calcutta (~1915–1921), University of Dhaka (~1921–1947), and Banaras Hindu University (~1947–1956).
Haridas Sinharay was an Indology scholar who held posts at Maulana Azad College, attested in 1970 and 1990.
